name: University of Iceland
summary: Reykjavík university that teaches mostly in Icelandic; two of its BAs run in English: International Studies in Education and English Studies.

ib.text: A full IB Diploma is accepted for bachelor's admission; the IB Career-related Programme is not. HÍ's IB page says no English test or translation is needed. No points minimum is published.

dates.label: Application deadline for international applicants; certified transcripts due the same day

programmes.name: International Studies in Education
programmes.ib: 60 places, 30 in the international round. The page asks non-native speakers for TOEFL, IELTS, CAE/CPE or PTE, though HÍ's IB page says IB holders need no English proof; ask.

notes: Nordic citizens, Danes included, have until 5 June (documents by 12 June). HÍ does not say how IB results pending on 1 February are treated: ask before you apply.
The International Studies in Education BA does not qualify you to teach in Icelandic schools.
The first year of English Studies can be taken entirely by distance learning.
